programmes.d: Two brothers (Kurt Russell, Tim Matheson), one raised by Indians, seek their sister in the 1890s West.
A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.
A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.
The new doctor (Robert Francis) at a cavalry fort finds resentment at first, even more once he treats Indians.
A rancher (Glenn Ford) fights a land-grabbing cattle baron (Edward G. Robinson) whose wife (Barbara Stanwyck) and brother are having an affair.
A wounded cowboy (Tim McCoy) catches rustlers who use a trick branding iron.
A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.
Framed Texan (Robert Knapp) escapes for showdown with saloonkeeper (Walter Coy).
Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.
The Durango Kid attempts to thwart an outlaw's plot to turn peaceful Indians against neighboring settlers.
An outlaw (Richard Boone) and his men hold an heiress (Maureen O'Sullivan), her cowardly husband and a rancher (Randolph Scott).
A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) loses his beloved in a robbery and hunts the man (George Macready) to blame, who is living off the loot.
On a cattle drive to Kansas after the Civil War, an ex-Union soldier comes up against Apache and Confederate renegades.
Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.
An Indian sympathizer accused of running guns to the Arapaho is court-martialed by the man who framed him.
A Confederate colonel (Richard Widmark) makes a cattleman (William Holden) teach his troops how to herd Union cattle.
